GT was founded to bring something new: a cold wellness drink that's insanely tasty, balanced — and as profitable for you as coffee.

We are Israeli boutique makers. We hand-pick fine tea leaves and botanicals from around the world and turn them into unique concentrates — no preservatives, no added flavors, no artificial sweeteners.
Sealed, our bottles need no fridge and take zero cold-storage space; once opened they live in the cold — because it’s a fully natural product. Prep is four steps any barista learns in a minute.
Built for a generation of guests who want drinks with real value: an experience, not just a beverage. Welcome to a new world of drinks.

How do we start working with you?
Leave your details below — we’ll build a starter menu for your venue, with recipes, costing and staff training included.
Through a personal ordering link we send you on WhatsApp: pick products and quantities, and send. You can also just message us on WhatsApp with what you need.
We send you the full price list directly, with the costing for every drink. Leave your details below, or message us on WhatsApp.
Two ways. Pay on the spot in the ordering system, at a discounted price that drops as your monthly volume grows. Or credit at a fixed price, subject to credit approval.
Is there a contract or a commitment?
No contract, no monthly minimum and no exclusivity. There is only an order minimum, and you order whenever you like.

Yes, through our distributor, Ice Dream: the centre on Sunday, Monday and Thursday, the north on Tuesday, and the south and Jerusalem on Wednesday. An order that reaches us by 14:00 goes out on the next run to your area.
Mostly for places whose guests order water or soda today and want something more interesting. It extends the menu; it does not replace coffee.
Yes. A drink like this is a little less profitable than coffee, and far more profitable than ready-made drinks from the fridge. The full costing for every drink comes with the price list.
How long does it take to add the drinks to our menu?
One day. No special equipment and no long training.
How hard is it for my staff?
Four steps: glass with water and ice, add essence with our measuring tool, stir, serve. Any barista learns it in a minute.
Is there training for the staff?
Yes. Every product and every drink has a training video, and there is a drinks booklet with preparation instructions and costing for each drink.
No. Essences need only a glass, ice and water or soda, with no machine. Matcha also needs a frother or a whisk, and you can order every accessory from us.
We have been in the market for 8 years, with about 700 customers, among them R2M, the Kisu group, Nono Mimi, Vivino, Elita Ofek and Babka.
Natural tea essences, and powders: matcha, ube and black matcha. Also Italian fruit purées and prep tools.
Premium tea leaves and edible botanicals — nothing else. No preservatives, no added flavors or fragrances, no artificial sweeteners.
Yes — Detox and Fresh come in sugar-free versions, same price, same flavor logic.
Yes. Every product is kosher, Badatz Beit Yosef, under the supervision of the Holon Rabbinate.
In our own factory in Holon. We import the raw materials directly from growers around the world, so production and import sit under one roof.
A sealed essence bottle keeps for a year, and powders keep for two years. Once opened, a bottle keeps for three months in the fridge.
Not until you open them. Sealed bottles live at room temperature and take zero fridge space. Once opened, keep refrigerated — it’s a fully natural product.
How many drinks come out of one bottle?
One bottle of essence makes 20–25 glasses. At recommended menu prices that’s the margin story your accountant will love.
Does it work in winter too?
Absolutely. Some of the drinks work great hot, like hot chai masala or a chai latte.
